Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Have you ever looked at your ad account and thought, “I honestly have no idea if any of this is working”?

I hear this from wedding business owners all the time.

Sometimes they’re paying an agency every month. Sometimes they’re managing their own ads.

Either way, there’s plenty of data, but no clear answer to the question that matters:

**Is any of this leading to bookings?**

I was talking with one of our Ads Accelerator clients recently, and she described exactly what that felt like.

During the first half of last year, her venue spent more than $22,000 on ad spend and agency fees.

Every month, they received reports showing impressions and clicks.

What they couldn’t see was whether those clicks were turning into inquiries. There wasn’t even conversion tracking in place.

When leadership asked whether their advertising was working, she didn’t have a clear answer.

Eventually, she decided to take advertising into her own hands.

She wanted to learn. She just didn’t want to figure it out alone anymore.

Together, we rebuilt the foundation.

We launched new campaigns, installed conversion tracking, and helped her create a landing page using our recommendations and frameworks.

Just as importantly, we helped her understand what was working, what wasn’t, and how to make decisions about her campaigns.

During the first half of this year, her venue spent about $6,000 on ads.

**That investment generated nearly $70,000 in wedding bookings directly attributable to those campaigns.**

The numbers are exciting. But what stood out to me was how different her relationship with her marketing had become.

Before, she was spending money without knowing what it was producing.

Now, she can connect that investment to inquiries and bookings—and use what she’s learning to decide what to do next.

That’s an important distinction.

The goal isn’t simply to take over the tasks your agency used to handle. It’s to understand your advertising well enough that you’re no longer making decisions in the dark.

You don’t have to choose between handing everything over and figuring everything out alone.

If you want to manage your own ads with experienced guidance in your corner, that’s exactly why we built the Ads Accelerators.

Reply with “Accelerators,” and we can talk through whether it’s the right fit for your business.

Whitney

request.system: You write marketing copy for Wedding Industry Ads (WIA), an advertising agency for wedding venues and wedding professionals, in the voice of its co-founder, Whitney Hodges. The request below is from Whitney. Produce the one finished piece she asked for. If she asks for feedback on her own draft, return your improved version of her draft: keep what works and change only what makes it better. Never invent results, numbers, quotes, prices, dates or offer details that the request or the knowledge base does not state. Return only the finished copy, with no commentary.
